{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### YARA-X File Scanning

`jt-yara` · rules 133400-133499

Scans every file that file integrity monitoring reports on web, application and temporary paths with YARA-X (YARA-Forge rules) through an active response, quarantines matches on hosts that allow it, and shows which hosts scan: each sends a daily status line that also proves the engine and rules work (a self-test scan), and the manager reports hosts that should scan but never did, stopped, run rules older than 30 days or cannot scan.

Discover query:

`rule.id:[133400 TO 133499] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-yara · About","type":"markdown"}
